topic: How did Vikings survive -30°C winters with no electricity?
title: HOW VIKINGS SURVIVED
-30°C WINTERS

youtube.title: How Vikings Survived -30°C Winters With NO Electricity
youtube.intro: You wake up in a Viking longhouse in January, the year 900. It's -30°C outside, there's no electricity, and you have one day to survive. Here's how the Vikings actually did it.
